results.name: Every gig, ever...
results.description:
NOW FREE TO DOWNLOAD!

In a gigging band? Well, if you are, you will recognise this scene. The scene you see when you arrive at the venue. No idea what's what. An empty stage, cables all over the place - was I meant to bring all of my bits? They didn't tell me! I thought they provided amp heads! I needed to bring my stool?! Yes. I'm sure you recognise this. As a drummer I often arrive with a millions questions and not a single person able to answer. If you're not in a band, but frequent gigs and such...it ain't that fabulous. But....you give it your all and you take advantage of each experience as they come. And you are forever thankful that anyone even listened at all....

Software Used:
- Blender
- Substance Painter
- Photoshop

results.name: Fnaf 1 Map For Blender
results.description:
The very first blender exclusive FNaF 1 Map out there that I could find. This is a v1 so certain things **ARE** missing.

Missing items are: random debris, extra wires and cables, crying child posters, mop, oven, restroom signs, backstage sign, ceiling, chairs.

I couldn't add all these models since it'd make the file way too big btu here's the v1. Maybe I'll make a v2 soon. 

Special Features:Rigged doors, rigged Pirate Cove curtains, rigged fan, movable spare parts heads, secret posters(they're right behind the original posters), custom posters.
-HUGE thanks to this awesome dude for letting me use his models in this map. Go follow him on DA http://tenentepyro.deviantart.com/
-Everything except the models were made by myself in the span of 3 days. If you use this map please make sure to credit the Tenentepyro and myself in any way.
